task_completion.description: Agent accesses the Nx Witness REST API documentation or interacts with the API endpoints via a browser or tool.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Browser showing 'https://localhost:7001' or API documentation pages for Nx Witness.

task_completion.description: Agent performs authentication using the provided credentials (admin/Admin1234!).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Login screens, HTTP basic auth prompts, or 'auth' tokens visible in API response headers/bodies.

task_completion.description: Agent successfully calls endpoints for System Info and Servers.
task_completion.visual_evidence: JSON responses in the browser or terminal showing system name, version, or server lists from /rest/v1/system/info and /rest/v1/servers.

task_completion.description: Agent successfully calls endpoints for Devices (Cameras) and Users.
task_completion.visual_evidence: JSON responses showing camera lists and user accounts from /rest/v1/devices and /rest/v1/users.

task_completion.description: Agent successfully calls endpoints for Layouts, Event Rules, and System Settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: JSON responses showing layout configurations, event rules, and global system settings.

task_completion.description: Agent assembles the retrieved data into the specified JSON structure with metadata.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing a JSON object containing 'metadata', 'systemInfo', 'servers', 'devices', 'users', 'layouts', 'eventRules', and 'systemSettings' keys.

task_completion.description: Agent saves the compiled JSON to the specific path /home/ga/dr_export/disaster_recovery_config.json.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command (e.g., 'cat', 'ls', or 'save') confirming the file exists at the exact path /home/ga/dr_export/disaster_recovery_config.json.

integrity.description: Agent did not simply create a file with dummy data without querying the API.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the agent actually navigating to or requesting the localhost:7001 endpoints before the file is created.

integrity.description: Agent interacted with the Nx Witness VMS environment rather than just using echo commands to create the file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Presence of browser tabs or API client tools (like Postman or Insomnia) showing live responses from the local server.

integrity.description: Agent used the specific directory requested and did not use temporary or home directories as shortcuts.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file path in terminal or file manager matches /home/ga/dr_export/.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Nx Witness REST API is hosted at https://localhost:7001. Verified endpoints include /rest/v1/system/info (System Info), /rest/v1/servers (Servers), /rest/v1/devices (Cameras), /rest/v1/users (Users), /rest/v1/layouts (Layouts), /rest/v1/eventRules (Event Rules), and /rest/v1/system/settings (System Settings). The final JSON must contain exactly these 8 top-level keys: metadata, systemInfo, servers, devices, users, layouts, eventRules, and systemSettings. The metadata block must include exportTimestamp, systemName, and exportVersion: '1.0'.
